3Critterpass: every screen, 100 in all
A guide for every place
Critterpass plans group trips with an AI guide that lives at the destination. Each place has its own creature with a colour and a voice. The guide drafts the plan, pitches it to the crew, runs the day, and ends up on your pass once you've been there.
HOW TO READ THIS
Two trips run through it. The Bali Six are 17 days out from Bali, which covers planning, money and the trip itself. They are also voting on the next one: Kyoto wins and goes through setup and the proposal.
Anything that moves on a screen is live. The line under each phone describes its motion and how it moves to the next screen.
Critters can't be bought. You earn them by being somewhere, and encounters reward staying put.

4Subscriptions: Pass+ and Trip Boost, 20 screens
Pay for yourself, or boost the trip
Two paid options that stack. Pass+ follows one person into every crew. A Trip Boost sits on one trip, like a server boost: anyone in the crew can buy it, it unlocks the crew-level features for everyone, and the cost can be split through Balances like any other expense.
RULES
First trip free. A crew’s first trip is boosted for free, and everyone has Pass+ until a week after landing. For the Bali Six that’s Oct 12–26.
When a boost ends. It runs until 7 days after the trip, so settling up and the recap are covered. The plan, album, recap and map trail are kept for good. Redrafts, the live map and new seats past 6 pause. Nobody is removed from the crew.
Who buys. Anyone in the crew. Split it and each person’s share lands in Balances. A cancelled trip moves its boost to the next one.
Always free. Voting, planning, splitting money, offline maps and every critter. Critters are never for sale.
FREE
$0Everyone
  • 30 guide answers a day
  • 3 redrafts per trip
  • Crews up to 6
  • 2 app icons
  • Sponsored picks in Explore
PASS+
$3.99/mo · $29.99/yrOne person, every crew they’re in
  • Unlimited guide chat, voice, camera
  • Bookings imported from email
  • All app icons and critter avatars
  • No sponsored picks
TRIP BOOST
$12 a trip · $59/yr per crewOne trip, the whole crew
  • Unlimited redrafts and plan changes
  • Live crew map
  • Crews up to 16
  • Everyone gets Pass+ features on trip days
  • Yearly includes Pass+ for the buyer
4ePaywall, final: the visa page. Picked over the boarding pass and gold cover because the app is already a passport: critters are stamps, the boost success is an entry stamp, the icon is a passport. One page holds both offers, where the other two favour one. This pass adds a holographic visa with a light sweep, machine-readable lines, the stamps landing in order, and a welcome page.
